about: Links a housing or credit law does not show in a played world, with the registered stopgap behind each. None are declared now: the consumer-loan rate cap's outcome-web link is shown past its 12-month lag by dev mode's loan-cap proof (src/bench/dev-loan-cap.test.ts), which passes the cap through a real bill, votes down repeals and runs the world until the lender reads the factor.
